preview_command: Reconstruct the retained workspace, then run python3 -m http.server 4406 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory app/dist. Source and lockfile are retained for npm run build after installing declared dependencies. Use ?theme=light&lang=en or ?theme=dark&lang=zh.
capture_conditions: Chrome headless shell 143.0.7499.4, Playwright 1.57.0, recorded CJK font, DPR 1; 1440x900,1280x600,390x844; English/light and Chinese/dark. Main streaming episodes use reduced motion, keyboard/coupled-growth use normal motion. Local synthetic stream, sampled stills and touch emulation.
